cards.scope: David with the Head of Goliath
cards.claim: Massimo Stanzione is the artist of the "David with the Head of Goliath" work.
cards.quote: David with the Head of Goliath (Massimo Stanzione) Massimo Stanzione's David with the Head of Goliath is exhibited at the San Diego Museum of Art. In 1947, Mrs. Harry Turpin gifted a Stanzione original painting titled "David With the Head of Goliath" to the Fine Arts Gallery of San Diego (now the San Diego Museum of Art); the work was then attributed to Ribera, but was reattributed to Stanzione by Mario Modestini in 1951, an attribution confirmed by Schleier, Felton, Zeri, and Spinosa.
